what: World rendering behind pre-match screens, with GraaoApp.coverThrottle off (before) and on (after)
method: Animation loop paused; 20 warm-up frames, then 120 synthetic frames at 60 Hz (2 simulated seconds) per screen driven through app.frame(t). GPU time of every world render measured with EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2. The browser pane delivered ~1.5 rAF/s without focus, so live FPS was not used.

machine.client: bench Vite server (no HMR), development build

limits: Single run on one machine; the compositor cost of the draft's backdrop blur is not included; CPU ms per frame includes JavaScript only. The menu keeps full rate on purpose (the character is the subject there).
